author: Desherion McBroom
title: DeWitt and Laingsburg capture soccer district titles - NewsBreak
text:
By Desherion McBroom ,
15 minutes ago
DeWitt, MI. (WLNS) — DeWitt captures a Division 2 district title, while Laningsburg would capture a Division 4 district title.
DeWitt defeated Lansing Eastern 1-0 to end the Quakers' historic season and claim their seventh district title in the past eight seasons.
The only goal of the game was scored by DeWitt freshman Jake Wever, who scored in the 19th minute.
With the loss, the Quakers' historic season, in which they won the CAAC Gold Cup for the first time in program history and finished with the best record in program history came to an end.
"Eastern was a great team, hats off to them and everything they accomplished this year," said DeWitt soccer coach Joe Ishraidi. "We knew it was going to be a tough game and we lost a lot last year. Not just quality players but leadership and guys that had been here and these guys had to find their own way," Ishraidi explained. "We have 13 seniors and we took a little bit of a different path but trough the grind they learned how to persevere."
Laingsburg took down Lansing Christian 1-0 to win the program's first district title since 2008. The Wolfpack did it under first-year head coach Brayden Thomas.
The two teams shared the CMAC title in the regular season after both meetings ended in draws. Laingsburg says it feels good to take home the hardware.
"It's amazing," Thomas said. "Credit to Lansing Christian. They were a great team and played their butts off, and just credit to our coaching staff and then these boys. They put the work in. They deserve it. I'm really proud of them."
Laingsburg will take on Saginaw Valley Lutheran in the regional semifinals on Tuesday, Oct. 27.
